title: Warm Charred Brazilian Chicken Empanadas
description: A diabetic friendly Brazilian dish featuring charred chicken and phyllo dough, served warm and cozy. This recipe uses a kadhai for cooking and an ice bath to shock the chicken.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a kadhai over medium high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken to the kadhai and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper to the kadhai and stir to combine.
Remove the chicken from the kadhai and place it in an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
Lay a sheet of phyllo dough on a flat surface and brush it with the beaten egg.
Place a few pieces of the chicken in the center of the phyllo dough and fold the dough to form a triangle.
Brush the outside of the empanada with the beaten egg and place it in the kadhai.
Cook the empanada for 2-3 minutes on each side, until it is golden brown and crispy.
